# Legacy snapshots

These files were generated by the unmodified main commit
`3641e77817d8f4821b01026884be1a04543a7c1b` on 2026-10-28 using the
Polars backend and `tests.simulators.dataframe_comparison._build`.

| File | Source case | Saved progress |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `simple.json` | `simple`, individual Experiment (the old collection has no JSON API) | task ID 9, scheduled time 17 |
| `single.json` | `single_interval`, collection | step 3, reference time 47, first task scheduled at 17 and completed |
| `multi.json` | `concurrent`, collection | step 3, reference time 47, first task scheduled at 17, IN_PROGRESS, slow_machine assignment |

Each source was scheduled with `execute_scheduling()` before these progress
values were set and its existing `to_json()` was called. The parent path is
`/tmp/gems-legacy-snapshot-runtime/{single,multi}`; the reader must not create it.
The single-machine State has no configuration. The multi-machine TimedState
already had a custom serializer, so its settings are present in the old file.
Concrete Experiment subclasses and shared-reference information absent from
the old format cannot be recovered from these files.
